mapper.select: SELECT ce.equipment_id, ce.character_id, ce.slot_type, ce.user_item_id, i.item_id, i.name, i.description, i.image_url, ce.equipped_at FROM character_equipments ce JOIN user_items ui ON ui.user_item_id = ce.user_item_id JOIN items i ON i.item_id = ui.item_id WHERE ce.character_id = #{characterId} ORDER BY CASE ce.slot_type WHEN 'HAND' THEN 1 WHEN 'HEAD' THEN 2 ELSE 99 END

SELECT ce.equipment_id, ce.character_id, ce.slot_type, ce.user_item_id, i.item_id, i.name, i.description, i.image_url, ce.equipped_at FROM character_equipments ce JOIN user_items ui ON ui.user_item_id = ce.user_item_id JOIN items i ON i.item_id = ui.item_id WHERE ce.character_id = #{characterId} AND ce.slot_type = #{slotType} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO character_equipments ( character_id, slot_type, user_item_id ) VALUES ( #{characterId}, #{slotType}, #{userItemId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_item_id = VALUES(user_item_id), equipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
